[6:48AM] #LagIbdExpWay
#3MB
#TrafficUpdate

Traffic is still very encouraging coming inward Berger from Kara bridge all the way to Emergency centre.
It's a bit slow between Tollgate turning and Ikosi/7up bus stop due to the bus stop activities.

Moving ahead to China Town and Alapere is better with another delay at Ogudu and Iyana Oworo due to bus stop activities, coupled with the influx of Vehicles coming from Gbagada.

Inward and outward of the Third mainland bridge is still an encouraging Vehicular flow.
#FollowLASTMA
